text: Friends, the best time to visit Vietnam is here. You can visit Vietnam anytime between October and April and cover any city in the country. Why am I saying this? Because Vietnam is a very large country. So the weather changes in every region. But October to April is the time when you can cover the entire country. For instance, there are three main regions in Vietnam. One is the North, the second is Central, and the third is South. The North includes Hanoi and Sapa. Central Vietnam includes Da Nang, while South Vietnam includes Ho Chi Minh City and Phu Quoc, which has been trending for the last two or three years because the vibe you get there in three to four days is something you might not feel anywhere else. There are so many activities to do here, and you can enjoy many of them on such a small island. So, in today’s video, I will share a complete Vietnam itinerary, showing how you can cover all three regions in 7 nights/8 days or 8 nights/9 days with the main activities, and if you have two or three extra days, you can cover even more. I will tell you what those things are as well. And yes, you will get every detail about your budget, visa, and flights in this video. You can come here and DM me. I will reply to you there. So, let's start with the visa. Many people are still confused about whether they need a visa for Vietnam or not. Well, there are two scenarios. If you go to Phu Quoc directly without landing in any other city in Vietnam. For example, if you are coming from a country that is visa-free for Indians, like Thailand or Malaysia, you don't have any visa requirements. But if you take a VietJet flight and land in Hanoi, or if you want to cover Phu Quoc or any city in Vietnam, you will need an e-visa, which gets approved in four to five days and costs 25 USD, which is about ₹ 2500 currently. You don't need many documents for the visa; you just need a scanned passport-size photo with a white background, your passport, and your entry and exit points—like if you are arriving in Hanoi and departing from Ho Chi Minh City, that is very important. You have to enter your date of entry and exit, and you can provide the details or address of your first hotel stay, and your visa will easily get approved within four to five working days. I have already made a detailed video about the visa. On how you should apply for it. It is a very simple process. You all can apply for the visa. Just be very careful while applying. There are many fraudulent websites out there. So, stay away from them. You will find the link to the official website in the description of this video. So, apply only from there. Now, let's talk about flights. Look, flight fares from every city in India to every city in Vietnam definitely vary every time. If you want to cover all of Vietnam, you need to check flights from your nearby or home city to see which Vietnamese city offers the cheapest flight. From some places in India, you might get the cheapest flight to Hanoi. From others, it might be to Da Nang or Ho Chi Minh City. You will never find the cheapest flight to Phu Quoc because there are no direct flights from India to Phu Quoc at all. You will have to take a one-stop flight to get there. So, it is better that if you want to cover all of Vietnam, your first flight should go to Hanoi, Da Nang, or Ho Chi Minh City, and your return flight can also be from any of these cities, whichever one is cheapest for you. And for internal flights, book them in such a way that if you are going, you should cover Hanoi first, then Da Nang, because that is when you will get the best flight fares. After Da Nang, you can head to Phu Quoc, and after Phu Quoc, you can go to Ho Chi Minh City. If you are getting a good flight back from Ho Chi Minh and going to Hanoi, you can use this sequence to book the cheapest flights and travel internally with ease. If you want to travel by flight, there are other options as well regarding transfers, which we will discuss later in the transfer section. Now, let's talk about the itinerary. First of all, if you are coming to Hanoi and want to cover it properly, it is best to have four nights so you can cover Hanoi very easily. And the itinerary would be something like this: on day one, when you arrive in Hanoi, you should explore local Hanoi, meaning nearby sights like the Train Street and the lake, which you can visit. If you want to watch a puppet show, you can, and there isn't much else to do; you can walk around Beer Street and similar areas. One day is enough for Hanoi. On the second day, you can go to Ha Long Bay; you can take a day tour of Ha Long Bay, which you can get for ₹ 3,000 to ₹ 3,500. And if you want to stay overnight, you can do that too, which costs approximately ₹ 10,000 to ₹ 15,000, depending on which cruise you choose. There are four-star cruises, five-star cruises, and various other types of cruises available. And there are different cabins on the cruise as well. So, it depends on which cabin you choose for the final cost of the cruise, and the cruise tour also includes your pickup and drop-off. This means you will be picked up from your hotel and dropped off at your hotel. So, book that type of cruise because if you go privately, it will become very expensive. So, don't do that. If you want to travel on a budget, it is best to take a day tour of Ha Long Bay, which you can do for just ₹ 3,000 to ₹ 3,500, and it includes your lunch as well. After this , on day three, if you want to explore around Hanoi, you can take a day tour to Ninh Binh, where you can visit Mua Cave and other caves that you can cover . But if you don't want to go to Ninh Binh, you can go to Sapa. There is a one-night, two-day tour to Sapa from Hanoi. If you want, you can book that. For 10,000 to 12,000, you can get a tour that includes pickup and local sightseeing. You can book that, which will include your pickup from Hanoi. You will be taken to Sapa by bus. After that, sightseeing in Sapa, Cat Cat Village, nearby places, and many other activities are included. The next day, you will return to Hanoi. And after coming back from Sapa, you can stay in Hanoi that day if you wish. Otherwise, you can travel from Hanoi to Da Nang on the same day. If you don't want to cover Sapa, two nights are enough for Hanoi. One day can be for your Hanoi city tour. The second day can be for your Ha Long Bay day tour, and on the third day, you can come to Da Nang. Now , Da Nang is the main land of Vietnam. There is definitely a lot to do in Hanoi, but there is even more in Da Nang. Da Nang is located in Central Vietnam. So, if you want to cover Da Nang properly, having a minimum of three nights will allow you to cover everything very well. Even if you have two nights, you can manage. But three nights is much better. On day one, you should arrive in Da Nang and explore the city, including Marble Mountains and Monkey Mountain. After that, you can also visit the Dragon Bridge. Then you should come to the Coconut Village, where you can take the famous basket boat ride. After that, you will reach Hoi An, where you can explore in the evening; if you are coming to Hoi An, don't miss the night boat ride. If you wish, you can also stay for one night in Hoi An. Then you will return to Da Nang, and on day two, you should do a day tour of Ba Na Hills. If you want, you can also stay at Ba Na Hills. There is a Mercure property there, though staying is a bit costly. But if you want, you can stay there. If you don't want to stay, you can book a day tour of Ba Na Hills for 4,000 to 5,000 rupees. You can book via Klook or GetYourGuide, which includes meals, pickup and drop-off, and all activities and tickets. Everything including cable car tickets is included, and you can explore the Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills, which you must have seen in photos. After this, there is Fantasy Park and many other adventure activities here that you can do, and there is definitely a European vibe here, so you can also click photos and videos. See, if you stay at the Mercure Hotel, one benefit is that you get an early morning cable car ride. At that time, the people on day tours haven't arrived yet, so the crowd is very thin. So, with fewer crowds, you can get photos and such clicked on the Golden Bridge. So, this is the only reason why people want to go there and stay. After this, if you take a day tour, you will come back to Da Nang, and then you can come to Phu Quoc from Da Nang. See, if you are coming to Phu Quoc, you definitely need a minimum of three nights. If you want to cover at least the minimum activities of Phu Quoc, but if you have four nights, then that is even better. So, try to come from Da Nang to Phu Quoc in the morning, and as soon as you reach Phu Quoc, you should stay. If you have three nights of time, you should stay in North Phu Quoc. Although the hotels are a bit costly, your transfer costs will be saved completely. Because as soon as you arrive in North Phu Quoc, you should stay near Grand World. And yes, as soon as you stay near Grand World, you can cover VinWonders that day. VinWonders is Vietnam's largest theme park, where there are more than 100 rides. And never make the mistake of doing VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari in one day, because VinWonders is a very large theme park, so it will take up your entire day. In the evening, explore Grand World, where you can watch the Color of Venice show, take a water taxi ride, which costs ₹ 800, and you can book it online, and after that, if you want, you can visit the Teddy Bear Museum. Although, if you buy a ticket for VinWonders, you also get the ticket for the Teddy Bear Museum included. So, after visiting the Teddy Bear Museum, on day two, you need to explore Vinpearl Safari. Vinpearl Safari is the largest open zoo in Vietnam. So, after exploring Vinpearl Safari, you should relax a bit around Grand World in the evening. Or if you wish, you can also explore Sunset Town on that same day. Where you can watch the Symphony of the Sea show, which is at 7:30, and the Kiss of the Sea show, which is at 9:30. You can see that too. But if you want, you can take a little rest that day and do the 4-island tour the next day. Because when you do the 4-island tour, it's on a sharing basis where you get picked up from your North Vietnam hotel , and it includes the cable car and lunch. When they drop you off by cable car, they'll drop you at Sunset Town. So if you want, you can explore Sunset Town that same day, which will save you the cost of a one-way transfer. So, all you have to do is reach Sunset Town by around 5:30 in the evening, and then if you want, you can watch the Symphony of the Sea show at 7:30. Otherwise, don't miss the Kiss of the Sea show at 9:30, and you can take a one-way transfer back to your hotel in North Vietnam and then return on day four. So this is a perfect itinerary. If you have one more day, you can definitely explore Starfish Beach and Central Vietnam, where you can do some shopping and look around. But if you have less time, you can plan your 7-night, 8-day trip well with 3 nights in Phu Quoc, 2 nights in Hanoi, and 2 nights in Da Nang to cover all three regions of Vietnam. But now, if you have a little more time, you should travel from Phu Quoc to Ho Chi Minh City, because just like Mumbai is for India, Ho Chi Minh City is for Vietnam. The vibe here is absolutely great. If you want to party, you won't find a better place for parties in Vietnam than here. There is a nightlife and so much more to do here. For example, you can do a half-day tour of the Cu Chi Tunnels, and if you have time, you can do a day tour of the Mekong Delta, and after covering all these activities, you can head back to India. 10 to 12 days is perfect because you will easily be able to cover all of Vietnam. Now talking about hotels, the most expensive hotels are probably the ones you will find in Hanoi. But if you want hotels in Hanoi near the market or around the central market, where the Train Street, etc., are nearby, then even if you choose a 3 or 4-star hotel, Hanoi's hotels are a bit expensive. In Da Nang, you will find 4-star hotels that are very budget-friendly. But Hanoi's hotels are a bit pricey. Still, try to stay at a good hotel since it will only be for two nights. You will find many four-star hotels. For instance, there are many properties of Fiesta. There is Fiesta Centre and then Fiesta Grand, these are different properties where you can stay. Apart from this, you will find many properties in Da Nang as well. You can stay near My Khe Beach in Da Nang for a budget-friendly stay with a sea or ocean view. If you are staying at Ba Na Hills, I have already told you the name . It is the Mercure property. If you are staying in Ho Chi Minh City, the hotels there are a bit more expensive compared to Da Nang. And speaking of Phu Quoc, you can even find three-star hotels in the north of the island. They are right near Grand World and are quite budget-friendly. But if you want a four-star hotel in Phu Quoc, it gets a bit expensive. If you are traveling during peak season and want to stay on a budget, you can stay in Central Vietnam. You can find budget-friendly three-star and four-star hotels there. Now let's talk about transportation. The best option for transport is to use the Grab app, as it makes it easy to get from one place to another. You can book a cab or a bike, and if you want, you can even rent a bike, provided you have an international driving license. They also hold your passport, so be very careful and only go to a trusted provider, okay? Or you can even avoid it if you are traveling with your family. Another option is buses. In many places in Vietnam, you can find free shuttle buses, like in Phu Quoc. Especially if you are staying in the north, you can travel between places for free by bus, and similarly, if you want to go from Hanoi to Sapa, you can go by bus. If you want to come from Hanoi to Da Nang, you can also travel by train. Otherwise, train, flight, and bus options are all available. Now let's talk about the budget, which is the most important part. The budget depends on whether you are doing all the sightseeing; for a 7-night, 8-day trip with a minimum of two people, your budget, excluding flight fares, will be around 50,000 to 60,000 rupees per person. Alright? And if you include flight fares, it definitely depends on which city you are flying from. But still, it will cost ₹ 1 lakh per person including flights, because if you go during the peak season, the flights will be a bit expensive. If you go to Hanoi, a one-way flight will cost you at least 10,000 to 15,000. After that, from Hanoi to Da Nang, then Da Nang to Phu Quoc, then Phu Quoc to Ho Chi Minh, the internal flights will also cost about 15,000 to 20,000 per person, okay. After this, when you return, your return flight will also cost you around 10,000 to 15,000. So, it means your flights will cost around 40,000 to 50,000, and your total package will be around 1 lakh. Whether you go through a package or plan it yourself, you can assume that if your budget is ₹ 1 lakh per person, you can easily stay for seven or eight nights by changing hotels a bit. The budget I am telling you is for good four-star hotels. If you choose three-star hotels instead, then the budget will definitely change.
